Upper Text: [When Digivolving] You may use 1 Option card with [Plug-In] in its name or that's yellow and has a cost of 5 or less from your hand without meeting its color requirements or paying its cost. Place the Option card used with this effect on top of your security stack face down instead of placing it in your trash.[When Attacking] This Digimon may digivolve into a [Sakuyamon] in your hand for a cost of 1, ignoring its digivolution requirements.
